items.title: Replace stale browser-style E2E tests with reliable Electron workflows
items.verification: The default E2E command runs a small deterministic Electron matrix on macOS and CI, reports real executions versus skips, and covers editor-preview and full-slide geometry.

items.title: Keep tutor-core runtime data outside app.asar
items.verification: A clean packaged launch initializes tutor-core using only app userData paths and emits no app.asar write or ENOTDIR error.

items.title: Sanitize rendered Markdown and restrict external navigation
items.verification: A malicious Markdown fixture cannot execute handlers, load disallowed iframe origins, or open a non-allowlisted URI scheme in development or packaged builds.

items.title: Use one state model for modes and pane visibility
items.verification: Mode and pane transitions pass invariant tests without direct style cleanup, and every consumer observes the same current mode.

items.title: Add accessible names and preserve presentation semantics
items.verification: Axe and keyboard tests pass for editor and presentation controls, and every visible icon-only control has a stable accessible name.

items.title: Make presentation source, build output, and CSS ownership explicit
items.verification: One documented build command deterministically produces the shipped presentation asset, one canonical stylesheet owns slide layout, and CI rejects stale generated output.

items.title: Decompose renderer.js around workflow coordinators
items.verification: File opening, preview routing, file-tree orchestration, and pane transitions have independent modules with contract tests, while renderer.js no longer owns their mutable state.

items.title: Minimize Electron preload and remote privilege surface
items.verification: NightOwl runs with no unused @electron/remote enablement, a smaller typed preload API, sender validation for privileged IPC, and an explicit documented reason for every sandbox exception.

items.title: Add budgets for startup, file switching, preview, and large documents
items.verification: CI or a documented benchmark job records p50 and p95 startup, file-switch, preview-ready, and presentation-ready timings against fixed small and large fixtures with regression thresholds.

items.title: Refresh architecture, ownership, and build documentation
items.verification: Architecture and contributor docs match the current NightOwl directories, IPC names, feature loader, generated assets, workplan flow, and clean build procedure.

items.title: Provide structured diagnostics and recoverable view errors
items.verification: A user can copy a redacted diagnostic report for a failed view and retry or reset that view without restarting the app.

items.title: Give timers, listeners, observers, and watchers explicit owners
items.verification: Repeatedly opening and closing each feature leaves timer, listener, observer, filesystem watcher, and open-file counts at baseline.

items.title: Make structured record editing schema-driven
items.verification: A workspace can attach a declarative schema to JSONL or CSV files and receive typed controls, required-field validation, completion progress, and export validation without changing NightOwl source.

items.title: Fit complete presentation slides inside the viewport
items.verification: At the minimum supported window and in Present mode, every edge of a 16:9 slide is visible without internal slide scrolling or adjacent-slide overlap.

items.title: Make file opening and preview rendering latest-wins
items.verification: A rapid A-B-A file-switch test with delayed settings and markdown rendering always leaves the editor, preview, tab, status, and current path on the final A request.

items.title: Restore tracked macOS entitlements and clean-build preflight
items.verification: npm run dist:check and the hardened-runtime code-quality guard pass from a fresh clone before electron-builder starts.

items.title: Make presentation loading fail visibly and recoverably
items.verification: Injected feature-loader, React-render, and content-parse failures each show an actionable error and Retry returns to a rendered deck without restarting NightOwl.

items.title: Add a repository-owned local CI gate
items.verification: npm run ci:local passes from this linked worktree, reports capability skips explicitly, and npm run ci:local:release validates packaging inputs.

items.title: Make unit and integration tests portable across worktrees
items.verification: A fresh worktree with the documented dependency setup runs all unit and integration projects without hard-coded node_modules paths, port-policy failures, or leaked file watchers.
